'''Eldrak Korsin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] for the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire's]] [[Navy/Legends|navy]] in the [[Time/Legends|time]] before the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]. Korsin was a highly respected [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]], never losing a [[Starship/Legends|ship]] during his lengthy career. He had two sons, [[Yaru Korsin|Yaru]] and [[Devore Korsin|Devore]]&mdash;Yaru followed his [[Parent/Legends|father's]] footsteps into the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] navy, while Devore embarked on a career in the [[Sith mineralogical corps]], and the elder Korsin thoroughly supported them in all their endeavors. Eventually, Yaru won [[Commander/Legends|command]] of a [[Sith dreadnaught]] named the ''[[Omen]]'' over the competing Admiral Korsin, and became a respected [[Captain/Legends|captain]] himself. Yaru and Devore eventually disappeared along with the ''Omen'', after crash-landing on an [[Kesh/Legends|uncharted planet]] during a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] [[Skirmish over Phaegon III|mission]].

==Biography==
Eldrak<ref name="eldrak">Although Korsin's first name is not given in the original edition of ''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Precipice]]'', he is identified as Eldrak Korsin in the version of ''Precipice'' included in the compilation ''[[Star Wars: Lost Tribe of the Sith: The Collected Stories]]''.</ref> Korsin, a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], was an experienced [[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] who served in the [[Navy/Legends|navy]] of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]. Korsin came from a [[Korsin family|family]] descended from [[Tapani Empire|Tapani]] [[Noble/Legends|nobles]], who at some point became subjects of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. The Korsin clan became valuable to their new masters, working in commerce and industry, and interbreeding with the Empire's [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]]. As a result, Korsin was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], and he went on to become a highly respected [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]], never losing a [[Starship/Legends|ship]] in his long career. During his naval career, he served alongside his trusted [[Helm officer/Legends|helmsman]], [[Boyle Marcom]]. He [[Marriage/Legends|married]] a woman named [[Takara Korsin|Takara]],<ref name="paragon">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Paragon]]''</ref> and with her [[Reproduction/Legends|had]] a son, [[Yaru Korsin|Yaru]], who learned the trade at his [[Parent/Legends|father's]] side.<ref name="precipice" />

Unbeknownst to Korsin, he had another son, [[Devore Korsin|Devore]]&mdash;born to a [[Devore Korsin's mother|woman]] on a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] somewhere. Devore eventually sought out his father, and the Admiral embraced him without a second thought. The revelation encouraged Yaru to pursue a naval career more aggressively, and he rose through the [[Military rank/Legends|ranks]] to [[Captain/Legends|captain]]. Yaru's first [[Commander/Legends|command]] was of a newly-christened<ref name="precipice" /> [[Sith dreadnaught]]<ref name="crosscurrent">''[[Crosscurrent]]''</ref> named the ''[[Omen]]'', winning control of the ship over Admiral Korsin himself. Although he had never lost a ship for the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]], he had lost one to his son, an occurrence that irked Korsin. As for Devore, a [[Spice/Legends|spice]] addiction derailed his prospective naval career, so Korsin sponsored his efforts to become a member of the [[Sith mineralogical corps]]. In [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], Yaru and Devore, on a [[Lignan crystal|Lignan]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] [[Skirmish over Phaegon III|expedition]], disappeared along with the ''Omen'' and Korsin's old helmsman, Marcom.<ref name="precipice" /> In reality, they crash-landed on an uncharted world known as [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]], where the ''Omen''{{'s}} surviving crew went on to form a [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith tribe]]. Korsin's grandchildren: his grandson, [[Jariad Korsin|Jariad]], and granddaughter, [[Nida Korsin|Nida]], would be raised on Kesh.<ref name="paragon" />

==Personality and traits==
Korsin was an extremely reliable admiral for the Sith, never losing a ship during his entire career. Possessed of a ruddy and squat frame, which he passed on to his son Yaru, Korsin was very supportive of his children's pursuits, sponsoring Yaru's naval ambitions and Devore's efforts to break into the Sith [[Mineral/Legends|mineralogical]] corps. Furthermore, he accepted Devore without a second thought, even after not knowing of his son's existence. However, he still held a fair amount of pride and disliked losing command of the ''Omen'' to Yaru.<ref name="precipice" />

==Behind the scenes==
Korsin was first mentioned in ''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Precipice]]'', a [[2009]] [[eBook]] written by [[John Jackson Miller]].<ref name="precipice" /> Although Korsin's first name is not given in the original edition of ''Precipice'', he is identified as Eldrak Korsin in the version of ''Precipice'' included in the [[2012]] compilation ''[[Star Wars: Lost Tribe of the Sith: The Collected Stories]]''.<ref name="eldrak" />
